title: Mahindra Racing reveals M13Electro, its first Gen4 Formula E car: 600 kW (about 804 bhp), 0-100 km/h 1.8 s, 335 km/h, active AWD, 700 kW regen; de Vries and Mortara 4th season; Jarama testing from 16 Nov; season opens Mexico City 16 Jan 2027 after Jeddah moved to 16-17 Apr 2027.
headline: Mahindra's New Formula E Car: 0-100 KM/H in 1.8 Seconds

fact_sources.fact: Mahindra Racing revealed the M13Electro (digital launch, 15 Nov) for the 2027 Formula E season, first Gen4 car; only Indian manufacturer in Formula E
600 kW max power, about 804 bhp; 0-100 km/h in 1.8 s; top speed 335 km/h (208 mph)
Active all-wheel drive; regenerative braking up to 700 kW
Nyck de Vries and Edoardo Mortara, fourth consecutive season together
Pre-season testing at Circuito de Jarama, Madrid, from 16 November 2026
Jeddah double-header moved to 16-17 April 2027 (announced 12 Nov)
Season now opens in Mexico (City) on 16 January 2027
